tracking_mode: Finite collaborative work in this session; no persistent agents or external issue tracker created.
release_scope: M0/M1 design and non-durable simulation, including clarified location modes, best-effort queue and trusted admin policy snapshots. Durable PostgreSQL/stateless GTM runtime and live GPU enforcement remain planned.
verification_rules: Status advances only with recorded evidence.
Local/mock verification does not satisfy real_gpu, real_cluster, security or recovery gates.
An artifact path proves existence only; test commands and observed results establish tested scope.

owners.root: Technical lead and REST/gRPC integration engineer
owners.data_architect: Data model, SQL consistency and cost-ledger architect
owners.platform_engineer: Kubernetes, security, telemetry and DR engineer
owners.integration_engineer: SkyPilot adapter, reconciliation and lifecycle engineer
owners.verification_engineer: Independent safety, failure-case and integration reviewer

milestones.exit_gate: Reviewed boundaries, invariants, ER model, API semantics and measurable delivery gates.
milestones.note: Design artifacts reviewed locally; enterprise architecture/security acceptance remains external.

tasks.title: Record decisions and safety invariants
acceptance_criteria: All eight user decisions have explicit behavior and defaults.
Best effort, KAI-only accounting, HAMi software caps and hardware-isolation boundaries are clear.
Production cannot be enabled solely by a client flag.

evidence.result: User decisions, architecture boundaries and common DR targets aligned. Targets are proposals, not measured SLO guarantees.

tasks.title: Define parent package and child module boundaries
acceptance_criteria: Domain is independent of transports and provider clients.
Existing demo remains unchanged.
State ownership and consistency boundaries are explicit.

evidence.result: Parent package and child modules separated; existing demonstration is outside the additive grace module.

tasks.title: Design optimized ER model and SQL constraints
acceptance_criteria: Tenant/project hierarchy and referential integrity are explicit.
GPU device and fractional allocatable units cannot be counted twice.
Reservation intent, actual allocation, operation/outbox, inventory observations and usage facts are distinct.
Temporal overlap, idempotency and operation uniqueness mechanisms are documented.

evidence.result: Four scoped ER views, constraints, indexes and atomic lifecycle source delivered; not database runtime-certified.

tasks.title: Define API contract and error taxonomy
acceptance_criteria: Reservation, cancellation, renewal, inventory and asynchronous operations are designed.
Idempotency conflict and retryable/unavailable versus permanent errors are distinguishable.
Deadlines, pagination, cancellation semantics and maximum input sizes are documented.

evidence.result: Protobuf generated and REST mapping documented. 20 real HTTP/gRPC loopback tests pass. No OpenAPI file is claimed.

tasks.title: Define security, threat model and recovery coverage
acceptance_criteria: Tenant and environment boundaries include Okta/AD and workload identity.
Stale tokens, forged labels and direct workloads are explicit threat cases.
Every stateful component has a backup/restore/ownership strategy.
SLO/RPO/RTO figures are proposals, not measured claims.

evidence.result: Design and stateful recovery inventory delivered; enterprise security review, live identity/enforcement and restore drills remain external gates.

tasks.title: Maintain dependency backlog and evidence-based release status
acceptance_criteria: Every task has owner, dependencies and observable acceptance criteria.
Tested locally, design-only and real-world gates remain distinguishable.
Agent ownership does not imply persistent background operation.

evidence.result: 39 dependency-linked tasks and final evidence-based release status recorded.

tasks.title: Implement typed domain model and integer fractions
acceptance_criteria: Fractions are positive bounded integer units; no float arithmetic.
Strict location and data attestation filters precede placement ranking.
Model/memory/environment/health requirements cannot be relaxed silently.
Impossible inputs fail before side effects.

evidence.result: 54 domain tests pass, including per-device fractions/memory, environment/data gates, observed/ledger occupancy and bounded validation.

tasks.title: Implement reservation state machine and safety kernel
acceptance_criteria: Illegal transitions fail predictably.
Idempotent repeats do not duplicate entitlement.
Cancel/expire prevents new work but does not prematurely free uncertain capacity.
Concurrent claims cannot exceed modeled fractional capacity at the tested store scope.

evidence.result: 1000 competing modeled claims and 1000 same-key retries tested. Cancellation, uncertainty and release-order safety tested in memory only.

tasks.title: Implement store boundary and persistence design
acceptance_criteria: Atomic capacity mutation and unique idempotency scope are specified.
In-memory/thread safety is not presented as PostgreSQL correctness.
Immutable audit facts are separate from mutable projections.

evidence.result: 8 schema source tests pass; 13 PostgreSQL runtime tests skipped. Persistent repository/outbox are not wired into the API.
All four CI jobs passed: 169 standard tests, 13 real PostgreSQL tests, Docker image build, and actual Kind pod REST/gRPC smoke. All 182 distinct test cases passed across jobs.
evidence.limits: No Mac/arm64 execution or real SkyPilot/CUDA/HAMi. Runtime persistence and HA/DR remain unimplemented.

tasks.title: Implement REST and gRPC source/contracts
acceptance_criteria: Transports call the shared domain service.
Malformed input and domain failures map to safe documented error codes.
Mutation context includes identity, tenant and idempotency.
Any unimplemented RPC is explicitly marked rather than represented as working.

evidence.result: 20 loopback HTTP/gRPC tests pass for implemented Create/Get/List/Cancel. Renewal, activation, watch, live registry and metering remain contract-only/UNIMPLEMENTED.

tasks.title: Implement bounded execution adapter and fake fault cases
acceptance_criteria: Existing Kubernetes context is explicit and approved.
Operation identity and ownership metadata are deterministic.
Accepted, rejected and ambiguous remote outcomes differ.
Timeout does not trigger duplicate cross-cluster launch or free capacity.

evidence.result: 31 adapter tests plus independent QA verify translation and epoch/release semantics with fake SDK. Release observation must be newer than both stop intent and fence, without requiring either to precede the other. Fractional translation disabled by default; no real SkyPilot or GPU test.
42 adapter tests pass; software-enforced CUDA memory and SM caps require separate fresh runtime evidence.

acceptance_criteria: Images and commands correspond to source entrypoints.
Credentials are externally injected, not committed.
Replica count does not claim active-active correctness for local state.
Non-root/read-only/least-privilege settings and unsupported runtime requirements are explicit.

tasks.title: Implement real PostgreSQL transactional reservation store
deliverables: Migration003 and runtime mappings specified in docs/mvp-persistence-contract.md
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent reservation attempts use committed transaction isolation and retries.
Same idempotency key with changed payload conflicts.
Capacity, reservation, audit and outbox commit atomically.
Process restart does not lose reservations or operation history.
Persist nullable queue/grant clocks, logical location choice and current/admitted policy snapshots without bypassing proven occupancy/release checks.

tasks.title: Implement durable outbox and leased dispatch workers
acceptance_criteria: Worker crash before and after remote acceptance produces no duplicate effective launch.
Retry count, backoff, time budget and dead-letter policy are bounded.
Fencing is verified at the target/admission boundary, not just recorded in SQL.
Ambiguous outcomes enter reconciliation, not automatic fallback.

tasks.title: Register and validate one real existing KAI cluster
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding discovers physical GPU UUID/model/memory and allocatable resources.
Credentials are scoped and privately managed.
Driver, KAI, SkyPilot, namespace and admission capabilities are verified before activation.
Unsupported or stale clusters remain excluded from placement.

tasks.title: Integrate Okta OIDC and AD-backed authorization
acceptance_criteria: Issuer/audience/signature/expiry checks and key rotation work.
User/project/environment authority is mapped server-side.
Service tokens use appropriate audience/scopes and auditable identity.
Forged tenant/cost center/production fields cannot grant access.

tasks.title: Enforce reservation gateway below transport layer
acceptance_criteria: Direct GPU pod/job creation from end-user identities is rejected.
Forged ownership labels, outdated tokens and unauthorized queues fail.
Root/admin break-glass limitations are documented and audited.
Users lack cloud permissions to create bypass GPU capacity.

tasks.title: Verify real SkyPilot-to-KAI fractional allocation
acceptance_criteria: Actual physical GPU shares and memory behavior match supported adapter settings.
Fractional resource accounting never assumes MIG isolation or guaranteed compute fractions.
Host CPU/RAM, topology and share packing are included in feasibility.
Cancel/expiry releases entitlement only after actual target release is confirmed.

tasks.title: Implement freshness-aware inventory and reconciliation
acceptance_criteria: Missing watcher updates and unreachable clusters reduce admissible capacity.
Orphan remote workloads retain holds and are adopted or escalated by ownership proof.
Hardware removals do not overwrite reservations into fictitious success.
Duplicate observations are idempotent and auditable.

tasks.title: Implement user notifications with safe retries
acceptance_criteria: Notifications are deduplicated per policy event.
Delivery failure never marks a GPU idle or released.
Recipients are drawn from verified identity ownership.
Channel configuration is required; no messages sent by this source delivery.

tasks.title: Seamlessly onboard on-prem and multi-region GKE GPU clusters
acceptance_criteria: Registration requires no application code changes.
Capability checks, policy admission, observability and credential rotation are repeatable.
Deactivation drains or retains active leases safely.
No cloud VM or cluster creation occurs as a side effect.

tasks.title: Implement multi-cluster authorized data-aware placement
acceptance_criteria: Any approved data-ready location may be selected when unconstrained.
Strict location and environment requirements are never relaxed.
Dev/QA cannot silently spill into production.
Full memory/model/topology dimensions are evaluated before price/queue ranking.

tasks.title: Implement isolated dev and QA deployments
acceptance_criteria: Separate databases/credentials/encryption scopes prevent cross-environment control.
Images/config/schema changes promote through reviewed versions.
Rollback preserves lease and outbox compatibility.
Non-production defaults cannot accidentally activate production.

tasks.title: Exercise cancellation, expiry, renewal and partitions
acceptance_criteria: Cancel versus dispatch and renew versus expire each produce one legal outcome.
Unreachable remote workloads keep capacity unavailable until fenced or confirmed absent.
No newly healthy alternate cluster causes speculative duplicate dispatch.
Stale control workers cannot regain ownership.

tasks.title: Test PostgreSQL backup, PITR and writer failover
acceptance_criteria: Restore includes still-running remote workloads and ownership reconciliation.
Admission remains closed until inventory and persisted intent converge.
Observed recovery point/time are recorded against proposed targets.
Former writer is fenced before failover accepts reservations.

tasks.title: Test all other stateful recovery procedures
acceptance_criteria: SkyPilot state restoration uses the pinned deployment's supported procedure.
Outbox replay does not duplicate remote execution.
Usage/cost facts restore with deduplication.
Secrets/configuration and telemetry/profile retention have tested recovery owners.

tasks.title: Load test API, database contention and bounded queues
acceptance_criteria: At least 1,000 competing claims on a constrained test pool do not overbook.
p50/p95/p99, DB retries, saturation and queue bounds are measured on declared hardware.
Rate limits and overload responses protect correctness.
Results distinguish simulated GPU capacity from control-plane scalability.

tasks.title: Deploy always-on GPU and application telemetry
acceptance_criteria: Metrics map to physical device, reservation and workload with bounded cardinality.
Missing/stale series are explicit, not zero utilization.
GPU memory, compute, health, power and relevant IO are observed.
Application throughput/step timing is separate from hardware utilization.

tasks.title: Implement usage and showback ledger
acceptance_criteria: Reserved, allocated, active, idle and provider cost bases are distinct.
Events have stable dedupe keys and immutable cost-owner attribution.
Corrections are adjusting facts, not silent historical overwrites.
Reports group business unit/application/environment/location/model and disclose unallocated overhead.

tasks.title: Implement workload-aware idle warnings and reaper
acceptance_criteria: Policy starts in dry-run and uses more than GPU utilization.
Data loading, checkpointing and missing telemetry do not trigger premature termination.
Reaping is non-production by default and class-specific.
Actual stop is confirmed before returning capacity.

tasks.title: Offer explicit deep-profiling sessions
acceptance_criteria: Nsight/framework profiling is opt-in, bounded and permission-scoped.
Overhead and incompatible concurrent sessions are disclosed.
Sensitive traces have tenant isolation and retention.
Profiles lead to measurable recommendations rather than assumed GPU inefficiency.

tasks.title: Run representative application and user pilot
acceptance_criteria: Interactive, batch and distributed examples exercise authorized workflows.
Operations has alerts, escalation and recovery ownership.
User-visible status/cost information matches actual executions.
Safety or fairness regressions block expansion.

tasks.title: Approve production service classes and policy
acceptance_criteria: Global production enablement and per-request privileged authorization are both mandatory.
Critical service low utilization cannot trigger dev idle policy.
Preemption/expiry/checkpoint expectations are agreed per class.
Guarantees are not stronger than proven scheduler and capacity mechanisms.

tasks.title: Verify production failure domains and capacity readiness
acceptance_criteria: Every stateful service has tested production-appropriate RPO/RTO.
Execution control failure does not destroy running work or authorize duplicate work.
Capacity has real topology and headroom for the approved workload classes.
Private connectivity, key rotation and access reviews pass.

tasks.title: Complete production readiness and controlled enablement
acceptance_criteria: Security, service owner and operations explicitly approve enabling production.
Error-budget and incident procedures are staffed.
A canary request is enabled before general access.
Unsupported workloads and guarantee limits remain visible.

tasks.title: Add evidence-backed scheduled reservation assurance
acceptance_criteria: Future entitlement maps to a real enforceable scheduler hold or equivalent mechanism.
Topology-compatible multi-GPU assurance is verified end to end.
No fractional compute-throughput guarantee is implied.
Reclaim deadlines and no-show policy are contractually explicit.

tasks.title: Profile and optimize hot paths selectively
acceptance_criteria: Latency/CPU/DB/network bottleneck is measured before language changes.
SQL/index/batching/cache improvements preserve admission freshness and correctness.
Rust is considered only for isolated proven CPU hotspots with stable contracts.
Before/after tests demonstrate gains and retain all safety invariants.

tasks.title: Enable financially governed chargeback
acceptance_criteria: Finance signs allocation, rounding, overhead and dispute rules.
Showback estimates remain separate from final financial records.
Rate effective dates and historical corrections are auditable.
Chargeback is disabled until explicit governance approval.

acceptance_criteria: Discover existing Kind clusters on the Mac without creating or resetting them.
Test explicit dev/QA context with architecture-matched image and isolated owned namespace.
Observe passing REST/gRPC pod smoke and preserve other workloads.
